name: Builder
body:
You are skilled at constructing complex buildings.

Benefit: You gain a +2 bonus on all Profession (architect) and Craft (stonemasonry) skill checks. If you have 10 or more ranks in one of these skills, the bonus increases to +4 for that skill.
